name: io.github.fileseal/mcp-send
description: Send a file to a person as a one-time, encrypted, auto-deleting download link.
title: FileSeal Secure Send

environmentVariables.name: FILESEAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: FileSeal API key, created in Settings. Sent as a bearer token on every call.

environmentVariables.name: FILESEAL_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: FileSeal API origin — set to https://fileseal.uk for the public API. Required here because the code falls back to http://localhost:3000, which is not useful for a registry install.
